addon.name: Mediabox
addon.provider-name: Mediabox, on Estuary by phil65 and Ichabod Fletchman

extension.summary: Mediabox: Kodi's Estuary skin with the Mediabox Home in the Space look
extension.description: Built on Estuary (Kodi's default skin, by phil65 and Ichabod Fletchman; GPL-2.0, artwork CC BY-SA 4.0), copied from the installed Kodi at build time. Mediabox adds its own Home, colours, fonts (Orbitron, Instrument Sans, Geist Mono; SIL OFL 1.1, see fonts/) and textures; every other window is Estuary's.
